q: How many customers do we have?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

q: How many products do we sell?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products

q: What is our total revenue?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed'

q: What is our revenue this year?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2026-12-31'

q: How many orders did we have last quarter?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'

q: How many orders were cancelled this year?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND order_date >= '2026-01-01'

q: What share of orders were refunded this year, in percent?
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(status = 'refunded') / COUNT(*), 1) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01'

q: What is the average order value?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total), 2) FROM (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.id)

q: How many items does an order contain on average?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(items), 2) FROM (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) AS items FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.id)

q: Who are our 3 biggest customers by total revenue?
sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3

q: What are the top 5 products by revenue last quarter?
sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

q: Which product category brought the most revenue this year?
sql: SELECT p.category FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1

q: What is the revenue per product category?
sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category

q: How many units of the Espresso Machine did we sell?
sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND p.name = 'Espresso Machine'

q: Compare our revenue in Q2 and Q3 of this year.
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.order_date < '2026-07-01' THEN 'Q2' ELSE 'Q3' END AS quarter, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY quarter

q: What was the revenue per month in the first half of this year?
sql: SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

q: How many active customers do we have?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_date > date('2026-10-25', '-90 days')

q: How many customers have never placed an order?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

q: Which city has the most customers?
sql: SELECT city FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: What is the revenue per city this year?
sql: SELECT c.city, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.city

q: Which 3 cities had the most completed orders last quarter?
sql: SELECT c.city, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 3

q: What is the most expensive product?
sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY unit_price DESC LIMIT 1

q: How much discount did customers get in total this year?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * (p.unit_price - oi.unit_price)), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2026-01-01'

q: How many customers signed up in 2024?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE signup_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'

q: How much revenue did we lose to refunds this year?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'refunded' AND o.order_date >= '2026-01-01'
